# Tool catalog

Every built-in tool, derived from its `ToolSpec`. `Side effect` and `Persistence
scope` drive blanket-authorization checks; `Sandbox` is what the kernel enforces
for the tool's child processes; `Deadline` is the tool's own declaration, which
a deployment's `[limits]` can override.

| Tool | Side effect | Persistence scope | Sandbox | Deadline | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cron_create` | `persistent_mutation` | `cross_conversation` | `full_access` | *(deployment default)* | Schedule a recurring AgentOS task. Persists a TOML file under workspace/crons/<id>.toml; the gateway scheduler picks it up on its next cycle and replays the supplied prompt whenever wall-clock time matches the cron expression. Use this whenever a user asks to schedule, automate, or repeat a chat instruction. |
| `cron_list` | `read_only` | `cross_conversation` | `full_access` | *(deployment default)* | Enumerate every persisted cron task (id, channel, conversation, cron expression, next-fire, enabled). Use this when the user asks which crons exist or wants to confirm a previous schedule. |
| `cron_remove` | `persistent_mutation` | `cross_conversation` | `full_access` | *(deployment default)* | Delete a persisted cron task by id. Use this when the user asks to cancel, remove, or stop a scheduled task. Idempotent. |
| `file` | `persistent_mutation` | `workspace` | `full_access` | *(deployment default)* | Read or write a UTF-8 file. |
| `http` | `read_only` | `none` | `full_access` | *(deployment default)* | Fetch an HTTP or HTTPS URL with a GET request. Only publicly routable addresses are reachable: loopback, private networks, link-local and cloud metadata endpoints are refused, on the requested URL and on every redirect it follows. |
| `job_kill` | `transient_mutation` | `conversation` | `full_access` | *(deployment default)* | Stop a running background job. |
| `job_output` | `read_only` | `conversation` | `full_access` | *(deployment default)* | Read a background job's output. Pass `offset` with the number of bytes already read to get only what is new. |
| `job_status` | `read_only` | `conversation` | `full_access` | *(deployment default)* | Report on a background job, or list every job in this conversation when no job_id is given. |
| `memory` | `persistent_mutation` | `cross_conversation` | `full_access` | *(deployment default)* | Store, recall, or forget persistent memory records. |
| `shell` | `persistent_mutation` | `workspace` | `workspace_write` | `300000 ms` | Run a shell command with structured arguments. The deployment's `[guardrails].shell_allowlist` decides which programs are accepted, and the command runs sandboxed: it may write beneath the workspace and the temporary directory, and nowhere else. |
| `skill_validate` | `read_only` | `workspace` | `full_access` | *(deployment default)* | Validate a workspace skill folder. Pass the skill `name` (lowercase hyphen-case) — the tool resolves it to `<skills_root>/<name>/` and checks the SKILL.md shape: frontmatter present and well-formed, required `name` and `description` fields, folder name matches `name`, body is non-empty. On failure returns a clear error string explaining what's wrong; on success returns the resolved path and a summary of the parsed metadata. Use this after every batch of `file` writes that build up a skill bundle, and loop until validation passes — the tool is the ground truth for whether the skill is ready. |
| `spill_read` | `read_only` | `conversation` | `full_access` | *(deployment default)* | Read back the full output of an earlier tool call that was too large to return inline. Pass the `spill:` locator the truncated result cited. |
